previewRevocation.detail: 4 previews worked with the retained credential before cleanup; after exact API-confirmed sandbox absence, three matched probes per URL with and without that credential returned HTTP 401/403 (access denied) or 404/410 (route absent). This does not establish independent token invalidation or physical storage deletion.
